ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Banned Books of the Borderlands. Meets with ANTH 359 CRN 61144. Taking the recent banning of "ethnic" literature in Arizona as the outgrowth of the new draconian border security initiatives, this course looks at daily effects of criminalized life in the US-Mexico borderlands. We will read several of the banned books as well as the social science and humanties treatments of US-Mexico border region, immigrant illegality, and related topics. We also look at the social movements and protests that have emerged in response to the bannings.
